page.title: Account restrictions and bulk actions
page.intro: Restrictions take effect on the server immediately. Forcing sign-out increments the account and client license session versions and removes current web and client sessions.
search.label: User ID, username, or contact
batch.title: Bulk actions by registration group
batch.intro: Enter at least one filter. The first request creates a preview valid for five minutes. Review the count and confirm again; the same account set is checked again before execution.
batch.preview_summary: This filter matches {count} accounts. The preview is valid for five minutes. Review it before confirming.
detail.title: Account details
action.confirm_impact: I reviewed the account and impact and confirm immediate action
identity.title: Triggered identity review (not required by default)
identity.help: Trigger manually only when clearly applicable to an unusual transaction, refund dispute, or regulatory requirement. Document numbers are stored only as keyed hashes, never in plaintext. The requester and reviewer must be different administrators.
identity.document_number: Document number (used only for this hash)
success.force_logout: Account restrictions took effect immediately and the current sessions were signed out.
success.identity_requested: Identity review requested. Another authorized administrator must review it.
success.identity_decided: Identity review decision saved and audited.
success.batch: Bulk action completed for {count} accounts and recorded in the audit log.
error.confirm_required: Select the confirmation box before continuing.
error.restriction: Account restriction failed. Check the input and permissions.
error.identity_request: Could not request identity review. Check the reason and permissions.
error.identity_decision: Could not save the identity review decision. Check the input and permissions.
error.identity_same_reviewer: The administrator who requested the review cannot review it.
error.batch_action_required: Select at least one bulk action.
error.batch_preview: Could not create the bulk preview. Narrow the filters or check them.
error.batch_changed: The matching accounts changed after the preview. Nothing was applied; create a new preview.
error.batch_apply: Bulk action failed. No changes were applied.
error.api: The operation failed. Check the input, permissions, and service, then try again.
